title: City Crews Are Working Around The Clock
description:
As the storm clears out of San Diego, our City crews are still out in full force. Our teams have been working before, during and after the storm citywide to keep San Diego safe. 

During the storm, emergency teams responded to rescue calls and traffic crashes. Crews were also monitoring storm drains and channels, building sand berms along the beaches, removing fallen trees and branches, and operating pumps to alleviate flooding. 

Report storm-related issues through the City of San Diego Get It Done app or visit sandiego.gov/get-it-done.
